main_text.p: ἐνδείξει τῷ ἔντος[?] significatione modi: cùm sci licet promittimus nos reprehensuros amicos, sed sine contumelia, conuitiis, calumniis. Et hæc in reprehendendo tũ sunt potissimum sententiæ adhibendæ, cùm eos vituperare necesse habemus, quos aliqua ex parte metuimus, aut hactenus benevixisse constat. Apud inferiores enim vel sceleratos atq; improbos simplex vsur pari reprehensio potest. Ad motus verò Sententiæ motu quod attinet, in vituperando animi eò ψυχικὰ[?] mo-ventes. sunt maximè perducendi, vt odio profequantur, execrentur, abiiciant illa vitia, quibus infecti videntur: pœnam etiam & pericula reformidare discant. Collocatio ac tractatio ita instituitur: vt prima pars Collocatio sententiarum. Exordium, constet, vel ἐπιτιμητικῶς reprehen-sione. lib.8.epist.15. lib.11.epist.18. vel ἀδυνᾶσθαι querela. lib.10.epist.1. Vel expositione causæ & occasionis institutæ scriptionis. lib.7.epist.12. lib.16.epist.17. pars altera argumenta cõtineat reprehensionis, desumpta à causis. lib.7.epist.12. lib.10.epist.25. Materiæ reprehensoriarum epistolarum. lib.11.epist.18. Adiunctis & circumstantiis. lib.11.epist.18. Testimoniis & iudicio aliorum. lib.11. epist.18. lib.16. epistol.17. Pars tertia & postrema conclufio absolua-tur: aut ἀφορμὴ[?] adhortatione. lib.7. epist.

page.notes: Gathering signature "n 5" at the foot. The first Greek word and the Greek words in the margin notes and at "aut ... adhortatione" are read with doubt and marked [?]. The margin note "ψυχικὰ[?] mo-ventes" is partly illegible and was read only with doubt. No catchword is visible. Printing errors are left as they are: "sententiæ" in the first line and "aut" before the Greek word. The printed lines read "potifsimum", "fimplex" and similar forms, which were copied as printed where legible.
